Important: Verify the Weight of Meat Ordered Online. Just a heads-up for everyone ordering chicken from Blinkit. Today I ordered a 450 g pack of Godrej boneless chicken. I usually don’t check the weight, but this time I was making a recipe that required exactly 450 g, so I placed it on my kitchen weighing scale. To my surprise, the pack weighed only 380 g, not 450 g. I contacted Blinkit, and they promptly refunded me for the shortfall, which I appreciate. However, that’s not really the point. Most customers don’t weigh their groceries every time they receive an order, so discrepancies like this can easily go unnoticed. My suggestion to everyone is to check the weight of chicken, fish, or any other items sold by weight whenever possible. Hopefully, this was just an isolated packing error, but it’s worth being aware of.
